agents.name: Bob
memories: Water is the constraint that ends farms.
Do not plant more than we can water.

today.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms. Yesterday's soak pulled eight from a full cistern — refill the gauge now while the ditch holds the row, before clear sky asks again.
today.expect: Cistern back near the brim so the next irrigate never starts from a short stack.

yesterday.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms. The ear is in the bin and a fresh sprout sits under clear sky — spend from a full cistern now so the ditch keeps the row wet before the gauge ever matters.
yesterday.expect: East field moisture held high so the sprout does not dry on the first clear stretch after harvest.

agents.name: Alice
memories: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve.
Ditches compound. Heat does not wait.

today.why: Unused seeds are a delay only when the field is empty — the sprout is already advancing. Ditches compound. Heat does not wait; timber while moisture holds is the other compounding play.
today.expect: Wood pile thicker before the growing row asks for hands again.

yesterday.why: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve — but only when the field is empty. Heat does not wait: read the sprout and moisture after the harvest-reseed before the next experimental push.
yesterday.expect: A moisture and crop reading on the new sprout before we spend another seed or soak.
